gaps.contract-dependency: Declarations are read from the exact locked 3.7.1 artifact and exercised by one capture-plan sweep. Fresh installation, adjacent-artifact refusal and the in-range upgrade workflow have no capsule evidence, and this capsule ships no version matrix.
gaps.native-behavior: Source reading covers the plugin's own registration hook and its registered storage. No target-side render is proven: whether a converged setting actually gates a block on the frontend is exactly what the withheld attribute surface would decide, so it cannot be shown while that surface is refused.
gaps.failure-recovery: capture-check.sh proves both refusals abort cleanly and that capture recovers byte-identically once the refused state is removed. No provider, lifecycle or rollback injection exists, and none can while deploy is unclaimed.
gaps.data-boundary: The settings option and the preset scalars have native capture witnesses. The refused surfaces have declarative controls plus refusal evidence, but no positive proof that a converged rule set means the same thing on a target.

blocked.identity-references: The plugin's entity references cannot be declared at all. blockVisibility is injected into EVERY registered block (measured 115 of 116 on WordPress 7.1) and nests ids at conditionally-typed paths: visibilityPresets.presets is a visibility_preset id list, and controlSets[].controls.location.ruleSets[].rules[].value is a post id list, a comma-separated post-id string, term ids or an author id depending on its sibling field. block_attrs binds ONE top-level attribute key per EXACT block name over a value vocabulary the engine closes at {int,int[]} (AttributeGrammar: 'any other shape needs engine support before it can be declared'), so neither the any-block reach nor the conditional nesting is expressible. Blocked by the engine, not by missing work here; tools/engine-gaps.json records the demand as any_block_structured_attribute_reference_paths. Until it ships, every block that can carry the attribute declares it a reviewed unsupported boundary so the state refuses instead of travelling as a source-local id.
blocked.clean-target: No native source-to-target deploy+apply is claimed or exercised. Additionally gated by the identity-references blocker above: a target apply that silently rebound nothing would be the failure this capsule exists to prevent.
blocked.dirty-target: Requires a target apply, which this capsule does not claim. Additionally gated by the identity-references blocker above.
blocked.derived-state: Requires a target apply, which this capsule does not claim.
blocked.deletion: No selectors declared and no apply claimed. Additionally gated by the identity-references blocker above.
blocked.concurrency-idempotence: Requires a target apply and recapture fixed point, which this capsule does not claim.
blocked.lifecycle: The disposition declares no lifecycle phase, because no deploy is claimed.
blocked.scope-platform: Explicit preset scope, real plugin combinations and the supported platform boundary are unproven; only the multisite refusal is declared.
